component.name: SettingsView

Label.text: OK: edit setting Back: return to menu

component.script:
sub init() m.serverList = m.top.findNode("serverList") m.passwordTask = m.top.findNode("passwordTask") m.passwordTask.observeField("result", "onPasswordResult") m.serverList.observeField("itemSelected", "onServerSelected") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "onFocusRequested") m.top.observeField("serverUrl", "onServerUrlChanged") m.top.observeField("programFontSize", "buildSettingsContent") m.top.observeField("onDemandUnlocked", "buildSettingsContent") m.editingIndex = -1 buildSettingsContent() end sub
sub buildSettingsContent() serverContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") serverItem = serverContent.createChild("ContentNode") serverItem.title = "Server URL" serverItem.description = m.top.serverUrl passwordItem = serverContent.createChild("ContentNode") passwordItem.title = "On Demand Password" if m.top.onDemandUnlocked passwordItem.description = "Unlocked for this session" else passwordItem.description = "Enter password to unlock" end if fontSizeItem = serverContent.createChild("ContentNode") fontSizeItem.title = "Live TV Program Text Size" fontSizeItem.description = m.top.programFontSize.toStr() + " pt" m.serverList.content = serverContent end sub
sub onServerUrlChanged() buildSettingsContent() end sub
sub onFocusRequested() m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onServerSelected(event as object) m.editingIndex = event.getData() if m.editingIndex = 0 showKeyboard("Server URL", m.top.serverUrl) else if m.editingIndex = 1 showKeyboard("On Demand Password", "") else if m.editingIndex = 2 showKeyboard("Live TV Program Text Size", m.top.programFontSize.toStr()) end if end sub
sub showKeyboard(title as string, currentValue as string) dialog = createObject("roSGNode", "KeyboardDialog") dialog.title = "Edit " + title dialog.buttons = ["OK", "Cancel"] dialog.text = currentValue if m.editingIndex = 1 then dialog.keyboard.textEditBox.secureMode = true dialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onKeyboardButton") dialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onKeyboardClosed") m.keyboardDialog = dialog m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog end sub
sub onKeyboardButton(event as object) buttonIndex = event.getData() if buttonIndex = 0 newValue = m.keyboardDialog.text if m.editingIndex = 0 saveSetting("server_url", newValue) m.top.serverUrl = newValue m.top.settingChanged = { key: "server_url", value: newValue } else if m.editingIndex = 1 m.pendingPassword = newValue m.keyboardDialog.text = "" m.top.onDemandUnlocked = false buildSettingsContent() else if m.editingIndex = 2 fontSize = parseProgramFontSize(newValue) if fontSize < 0 m.pendingFontSizeError = true else fontSizeValue = fontSize.toStr() saveSetting("live_tv_program_font_size", fontSizeValue) m.top.programFontSize = fontSize m.top.settingChanged = { key: "live_tv_program_font_size", value: fontSize } end if end if end if m.keyboardDialog.close = true end sub
sub onKeyboardClosed() m.keyboardDialog = invalid m.editingIndex = -1 if m.pendingPassword <> invalid password = m.pendingPassword m.pendingPassword = invalid m.passwordTask.uri = passwordUrl(m.top.serverUrl) m.passwordTask.password = password m.progressDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "ProgressDialog") m.progressDialog.title = "Checking password..." m.top.getScene().dialog = m.progressDialog m.passwordTask.control = "run" return end if if m.pendingFontSizeError m.pendingFontSizeError = false showFontSizeError() return end if m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
function parseProgramFontSize(value as string) as integer value = value.trim() if value = "" or value.len() > 2 then return -1 for index = 1 to value.len() digit = value.mid(index - 1, 1) if digit < "0" or digit > "9" then return -1 end for fontSize = value.toInt() if fontSize < 12 or fontSize > 36 then return -1 return fontSize end function
sub showFontSizeError() dialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") dialog.title = "Invalid Text Size" dialog.message = "Enter a whole number from 12 to 36 points." dialog.buttons = ["OK"] dialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onFontSizeErrorClosed") m.fontSizeErrorDialog = dialog m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog end sub
sub onFontSizeErrorClosed() m.fontSizeErrorDialog = invalid m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
function passwordUrl(serverUrl as string) as string value = serverUrl.trim() schemeEnd = instr(1, value, "://") if schemeEnd = 0 then return "" scheme = LCase(value.left(schemeEnd - 1)) if scheme <> "http" and scheme <> "https" then return "" authorityStart = schemeEnd + 3 endAt = value.len() + 1 for each separator in ["/", "?", "#"] separatorAt = instr(authorityStart, value, separator) if separatorAt > 0 and separatorAt < endAt then endAt = separatorAt end for if endAt = authorityStart then return "" return value.left(endAt - 1) + "/settings/ondemandpwd" end function
sub onPasswordResult(event as object) result = event.getData() if result = invalid then return m.passwordTask.password = "" if m.progressDialog <> invalid then m.progressDialog.close = true m.progressDialog = invalid m.top.onDemandUnlocked = result.matched buildSettingsContent() dialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") dialog.title = "On Demand" dialog.message = result.message dialog.buttons = ["OK"] dialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onPasswordDialogButton") dialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onPasswordDialogClosed") m.passwordDialog = dialog m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog end sub
sub onPasswordDialogButton() if m.passwordDialog <> invalid then m.passwordDialog.close = true end sub
sub onPasswordDialogClosed() m.passwordDialog = invalid m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub saveSetting(key as string, value as string) section = createObject("roRegistrySection", "AppSettings") section.write(key, value) section.flush() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key="left" m.top.closeRequested = true return true end if return false end function
